changelog: Add: challenges.drawdown_type (ENUM('static','trailing') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'static') -- FundedControl's Current Drawdown was always peak-to-trough (measured from the equity high-water mark), stricter than how Bitfunded actually judges Maximum Loss for this account: its own dashboard reports 264.82 used of a 1,000 allowance, exactly 10,000 - 9,735.17 (starting_balance - current_balance), not a peak-relative figure. 'static' (the default) measures from starting_balance; 'trailing' preserves the old peak-to-trough behavior for a firm whose rule genuinely is a high-water mark. Challenge 6 explicitly set to static

Fix: StatsController::getStats()'s current_drawdown_pct now branches on drawdown_type -- 'trailing' keeps the exact pre-v3.14.7 peak-to-trough calculation; 'static' uses the account's distance below starting_balance. Discovered while building this that 'static' was already the codebase's unspoken default everywhere except the one place it was actually labeled 'Current Drawdown': AlertController's MAX DRAWDOWN REACHED threshold and ReviewEngineController::ruleDrawdownProximity() were both already independently computing the same static formula, and StatsController's own sidebar dd_pct widget was already static too -- three near-identical inline copies, one of which disagreed with its neighbor (current_drawdown_pct) under a near-identical name. Unified into one shared helpers.php::staticDrawdownPct($challenge)

Change: max_drawdown_pct ('Max Drawdown') is unaffected by drawdown_type and always stays the peak-to-trough historical-worst figure -- genuinely useful context regardless of which rule the account is judged by. Relabeled in the Statistics page as 'Max Drawdown (historical worst)' so it reads as context, not as the live enforced number; Current Drawdown's active type (static/trailing) is now shown alongside it

Note (deliberate scope boundary, not an oversight): AlertController and ReviewEngineController::ruleDrawdownProximity() still always use static drawdown regardless of a challenge's drawdown_type -- trailing requires walking the full ordered trade history with peak-tracking, which only StatsController currently does cheaply (for the Drawdown Curve chart). Every challenge is static today so nothing currently diverges, but a challenge set to trailing would see its risk alert and Review Engine insight disagree with the Stats page display -- documented in CLAUDE.md v3.14.7 rather than silently left unexplained
Add: drawdown_type exposed in the challenge add/edit form and ChallengeController::add()/update(), defaulting to 'static' for new challenges -- not just settable via migration
